title: Get my event stream
description: The caller's Customer Analytics event stream, as a 0-or-1 element array — each user has at most one stream per project. Returns its `id` (needed by the other event-stream tools), enabled state, watched `event_names`, Slack delivery target, and member `account_ids`.

methodDocumentation.text:
The caller's event stream: a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a
Slack channel of their choice. Per-user — each team member owns at most one stream, and
every endpoint is scoped to the caller's own. Delivery runs through a managed CDP
destination that is re-provisioned inside the same transaction as every write, so
config and delivery can't drift apart.

The caller's Customer Analytics event stream, as a 0-or-1 element array — each user has at most one stream per project. Returns its `id` (needed by the other event-stream tools), enabled state, watched `event_names`, Slack delivery target, and member `account_ids`.
